Cooperative stint rules for leash checks
This page shows new staff what is expected

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, leash checks keep trips calm and prevent holds at the gate. New staff should greet each traveler, confirm the carrier or leash setup, and keep the tone easy so the animal stays settled. When a crate is in use, check that the fit matches the booking and that the latch, vents, and floor are sound. <<FACT F068>> If the animal is a reptile, review the travel record, then confirm the crate and its contents meet the handoff rules. <<FACT F066>> For cats, the health paper must still be current before any bag is tagged for loading. <<FACT F079>> If anything looks off, pause the desk flow and bring in the senior coordinator before the passenger moves on. Keep notes clear, keep the pace steady, and remember that careful checks save everyone trouble later.
